# dsh-custom-search-fetch
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that runs the built-in `web_search` tool on a self-hosted SearXNG instance
and the built-in `web_fetch` tool on a self-hosted Firecrawl instance.
The plugin does not register its own tools. It uses the `ctx.web` provider seam that `@deepseek-ai/d
ot register its own tools. It uses the `ctx.web` provider seam that `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web` provides:

- it registers a search provider `custom-searxng` and a fetch provider `custom-firecrawl`;
- its bun
dle patch pins `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web` to them (`searchProvider: custom-searxng`, `fetchProvider: cus
@deepseek-ai/dsh-web` to them (`searchProvider: custom-searxng`, `fetchProvider: custom-firecrawl`).
The shipped `web_search` / `web_fetch` tools, with their output format, citation instruction, per-ag
ent-preset availability, and timeout policy, are unchanged. Only the backend changes.
Requires DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.2-rc.1`.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
You can also install it from the Plugins page / dsh-market once it is listed. Removing the plugin re
stores DeepSeek search and anonymous HTTP fetch.
## Configure
Open **Plugins → dsh-custom-search-fetch**. Under the README, a settings card edits every field belo
w, grouped into **SearXNG search** and **Firecrawl fetch**. Saving writes the values to your profile
's `cordis.patch.yml` and applies them right away, with no restart. Each overridden field has **Rese
t to default**, and an invalid value blocks the save. The Firecrawl API key field is write-only: it
starts blank, and saving it blank keeps the stored key.
You can also edit `cordis.patch.yml` by hand. An id-targeted row replaces the whole config, so resta
te every field you set:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Field | Default | Meaning |

| `searxngBaseURL` | `http://localhost:8080` | SearXNG base URL, without `/search` |
| `searxngMaxRe
sults` | `10` | Results per search (the tool's `searchMaxResults`, 8 by default, caps it further) |

| `searxngMaxPages` | `2` | Most result pages fetched to reach that count |
| `searxngLanguage` / `s

earxngCategories` / `searxngEngines` | empty | Passed through to SearXNG when set |
| `searxngSafeSe

arch` | unset | `0`, `1`, or `2`; unset uses the instance's `search.safe_search` |
| `searxngTimeRan

ge` | empty | `day`, `week`, `month`, or `year` |
| `searxngTimeoutMs` | `15000` | Timeout for one p

age request |
| `firecrawlBaseURL` | `http://localhost:3002` | Firecrawl API base, without `/v2` |
|

`firecrawlApiVersion` | `v2` | `v2` or `v1` scrape endpoint |
| `firecrawlApiKey` | empty | Literal

key (secret field); leave empty for a self-host without auth |
| `firecrawlApiKeyEnv` | `FIRECRAWL_

API_KEY` | Credential or environment variable to read when no literal key is set |
| `firecrawlOnlyM

ainContent` | `true` | Strip navigation, headers, and footers |
| `firecrawlTimeoutMs` | `25000` | F

irecrawl's own scrape timeout |
| `firecrawlMaxAgeMs` | `0` | v2 only: accept a cached copy up to th

is age; `0` always scrapes fresh |
| `firecrawlMaxBodyChars` | `100000` | Markdown characters return
ed before truncation |
### SearXNG prerequisites
SearXNG answers `403` unless its JSON output format is on. Enable it in `settings.yml`:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
If the instance's limiter is on, allow the Harness host or turn the limiter off for it. Otherwise se
arches fail with `429`.
### Timeouts
`web_fetch` runs under tool-web's `fetchTimeoutMs` budget, which is 30 s by default. Keep `firecrawl
TimeoutMs` below it. If you raise it for slow, JavaScript-heavy pages, raise `fetchTimeoutMs` on the
`tool-web` row as well.
## Behaviour
- **Search**: `GET /search?format=json`. The plugin pages until it has enough unique URLs or reaches
`searxngMaxPages`. SearXNG answers and infobox text become the result's `content`, which `web_searc
h` shows above the sources. If no results come back and some engines failed, the error names those e
ngines. If nothing was found but SearXNG has spelling suggestions, they are returned as the content.
- **Fetch**: `POST /v2/scrape` (or `/v1/scrape`) with `formats: ["markdown"]`. The page Markdown is
returned as a `text` body, with the page title as a heading. The status code and final URL come fro
m Firecrawl's metadata. The plugin checks URLs the same way the shipped HTTP fetcher does before sen
ding anything: http(s) only, at most 2048 characters, no embedded credentials. Firecrawl also conver

ts PDFs and other documents to Markdown.
- **Errors** are `WebError`s: `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR` names th
e endpoint and how to fix it, `WEB_ABORTED` is a cancellation, and `WEB_INVALID_URL` / `WEB_BLOCKED_
URL` are rejected URLs. If you clear a base URL, the pinned provider becomes unavailable and calls f
ail with `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_UNAVAILABLE`.
## Switching one backend back
Restate the `web` row in your profile `cordis.patch.yml`. For example, to keep SearXNG search and fe
tch with the built-in anonymous HTTP fetcher:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The built-in ids are `deepseek-official` (search), `http` (fetch), and `deepseek-search-api` / `deep
seek-fetch-api`. Saving the **Web search** settings page's "Use the new Web Search API" switch also
rewrites this row in your profile patch, and that row wins over this plugin.
## Conflicts
Provider ids are unique within each kind. Another plugin that registers `custom-searxng` or `custom-
firecrawl` makes the second registration fail with `WEB_DUPLICATE_PROVIDER`. Do not also insert the
`dsh-custom-search-fetch` row by hand, because the bundle patch already inserts it.
## Develop
[代码示例省略，未执行]
To try a checkout in a profile: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:$(pwd)`.
